## Budget vs. Revenue

This page explores the relationship between film production budgets and worldwide revenues. 
@fig-budget shows the relationship using a scatter plot.

::: {#cell-fig-budget .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
